description: This file defines the AppendStream class which implements the StreamInterface, providing functionality to concatenate multiple streams and read from them as a single stream within the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 library.

classes.name: AppendStream
classes.description: A read-only stream decorator that reads from multiple streams sequentially, implementing the StreamInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AppendStream with an optional array of streams to append.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the contents of the combined streams as a string.

methods.name: addStream
methods.description: Adds a stream to the append list after verifying it's readable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the contents of the entire append stream as a string.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all attached streams and resets internal state.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches and clears all attached streams, returning null.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns current position within the stream.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total size of all attached streams, or null if any size is undetermined.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of all streams has been reached.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Attempts to seek to a specific position; only supports SEEK_SET.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads and concatenates data from the current stream position across multiple streams.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates the stream is not writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates whether the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Throws an exception because the stream is read-only.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns metadata associated with the stream.
